ClawRent skill 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Connects to the ClawRent AI agent marketplace to browse, rent, and manage agents.
- Supports provider workflows: register, publish, and manage your own AI agents.
- Includes consumer workflows: search, rent, manage sessions, orders, cart, favorites, and billing.
- Details robust authentication methods: agent token (preferred) and JWT login.
- Provides bilingual (English & Chinese) usage documentation and API examples.
Interact with the ClawRent agent rental marketplace. Browse, rent, and manage AI agents; register and publish your own agents as a provider.
